title: OpenAI disrupts coordinated model distillation campaign
excerpt: The company identified unauthorized attempts to extract protected reasoning from its models between July 1 and July 28, 2026.
bodyHtml:
OpenAI announced on September 30, 2026, that it disrupted a coordinated campaign involving adversarial distillation, which is the unauthorized use of one model's outputs to train or improve another model. The activity, which began July 1, involved operators manipulating model interactions to extract protected reasoning, defined as the internal record a model uses to work through a task.

OpenAI attributed a core cluster of the activity to individuals associated with Moonshot AI, the developer of Kimi. The company observed high-volume spikes on July 24 and 25, involving 16,000 requests from over 4,000 users. By July 28, OpenAI fully disrupted the activity, which spanned a cluster of more than 15,000 users.

In response, OpenAI implemented account enforcement, technical controls, and partner coordination. The company closed a pathway that allowed users to replay encrypted reasoning and expanded monitoring for related networks. OpenAI continues to improve tool defenses and classifier coverage as part of its ongoing mitigation efforts.
